record.question: Article 309 is related to which part of the Indian Constitution?
record.explanation: Article 309 (recruitment and conditions of service of persons serving the Union or a State) falls in Part XIV of the Constitution, titled 'Services under the Union and the States' (Articles 308-323). The printed Q50 on p.7 offers Part XIV as option (c).
